identity.name: GMT-Master II

case.bezel: interchangeable aluminum insert (red-blue, red-black, or black)

identity.one_liner: The 1989-2007 GMT-Master II with interchangeable aluminum bezels: Pepsi, Coke, or black.

narrative.story: The 16710 was the last aluminum-bezel GMT-Master II and the only modern reference that lets one watch wear Pepsi, Coke, or black inserts interchangeably. It ran caliber 3185, switching to 3186 in the final years — a detail collectors pay up for. Slim by current standards at 40mm, with drilled lugs for most of its run, it has become the default neo-vintage GMT.
narrative.collector_notes: Late 'stick dial' examples with caliber 3186 carry a premium. Verify insert originality — honest fading is desirable, but aftermarket fat-font reproductions are common.
